2645-3430-3861-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3861-7014.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

443-728-3249-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
443-728-3249-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2105-3899-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3899-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

222-527-1879-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1879-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

628-6495-7216.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7216.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-1477-5131-7650--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5131-7650--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Bilbo.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

252-4231-5394-7730.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-7730.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1394-2060-6797-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-3987-7068.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Baboon Spirit. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

710-4050-7424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

240-5231-5470-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4475-7319.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
4475-7319.description:
Declare Shredder as an attacker. Shredder's first ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of it attacking each other opponent that isn't legendary.
Deal combat damage using the Shredders. Each Shredder triggers, causing each opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn. Each opponent then loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

2281-3817-5231.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

3525-5268-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kragma Butcher.
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1495-2396-6822.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat.

4215-6730-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
4215-6730-6797.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

1563-1753-2457-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

3240-4050-5477.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {B}.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

5195-5802-6259.description:
Cast Verdant Touch with buyback by paying {G}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Verdant Touch.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2653-3438-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-3438-5702.description:
Activate Inkmoth Nexus's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Inkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to Inkmoth Nexus.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Inkmoth Nexus.
When the Inkmoth Nexus token enters the battlefield, Nissa and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Inkmoth Nexus token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 6.

110-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
110-6191.description:
Gain life.
Marauding Blight-Priest triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent that lost life.
Resolve a Bloodthirsty Conqueror trigger, gaining 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

101-2061-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
101-2061-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2061-2103-3277.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
2061-2103-3277.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2060-2744-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2034-2060-2744-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dargo, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

175-3525-4178.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.
175-3525-4178.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

132-1261.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-1261.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Time Vault's ability by tapping it, gaining an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-2034-3661-5222.description:
Cast Shield Sphere.
Equip Sword of the Realms to Shield Sphere for {0}.
Sacrifice Shield Sphere to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Shield Sphere to your hand.
Repeat.

147-1638-2060-3921.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Winding Constrictor.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

751-2060-2313-2854.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
751-2060-2313-2854.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {U}.
Shrieking Drake triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-2427-4125-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
